## Privacy check

Do not paste private source code, company data, secrets, tokens, databases,
internal paths, private evidence, or sensitive screenshots. Use a synthetic or
redacted task description.

## Minimal reproduction

Provide public-safe filenames or a tiny synthetic fixture only. You do not need
to upload your repository for us to investigate routing behavior.
